candidates.change_summary: Return the ERC165 supportsInterface selector instead of the onERC721Received selector.
Return the transferFrom selector instead of the onERC721Received selector.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken remains address(0) after initialize.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken always ends up as address(0).
Delete the assignment `nft = _nft;` so the nft state variable is never set during initialize.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so nft is set to the base token address instead.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so nft is set to the zero address instead.
Delete the assignment `changeFee = _changeFee;` so changeFee remains 0 after initialize.
Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = 0;` so changeFee is always set to zero regardless of the argument.
Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = uint56(_feeRate);` so changeFee is set from the feeRate argument instead.
Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = _changeFee + 1;` so changeFee is one larger than the provided argument.
Delete the assignment `feeRate = _feeRate;` so feeRate remains its default value of 0 after initialize.
Replace `feeRate = _feeRate;` with `feeRate = _feeRate / 2;` so the stored feeRate is halved.
